**May 27, 2026**

**Time: 6:00 PM**

**Location:**

Peck Center, Willie Mae Ashley Auditorium

516 S 10th Street, Fernandina Beach, FL 32034

**[Click Here for Meeting Live Stream](https://www.youtube.com/@adminoceanhighwayportautho2427/featured)**

Meeting Agenda

1. **Public Meeting Call to Order, 6:00 PM –** Chairman
2. **Invocation**
3. **Pledge of Allegiance**
4. **Roll Call:**  Miriam Hill, Sec/Treasurer-District 1; Scott Moore, Vice Chair-District 2; Justin Taylor, District 3; Ray Nelson, Chair-District 4; Mike Cole, District 5
5. **Welcome Guests** (Chair)
6. **Public Comments** on non-agenda items (Comments submitted prior to the meeting, limit 3 minutes per speaker)
7. **Consent Item**

   * PIDP 2026 Application 
8. **Old Business** (Public comments permitted. Limit 3 minutes per speaker)

   * Website Redesign  (Action item)
   * Fabric Warehouse (Finalize orientation- Action item, Updates on Rebuild Permit)
   * Crane 9 repair (CIMR Funds request)
9. **New Business** (Public comments permitted. Limit 3 minutes per speaker)

   * RFP Crane Refurbishment (Bid Tabulation, Action item- Vendor selection)
   * PTGA - 444933-2-94-01 - Port of Fernandina Customs and Border Protection Building (Action item)
   * USDA Rural Business Development Grant (Information)
   * FSTED Annual Meeting on August 26-27 2026 (Jensen Beach, Florida)
   * Facility Usage Fee (25%) and $50K one-time payment (Letter to the Port Operator)
   * City of Fernandina Harbor Master Plan (Contact person)
10. **Office Manager Report**

    * Financial report – April 2026
11. **Port Commissioner Items** (Other business to come before the Board)
12. **Adjournment**
